definitions.explanation: Hair that grows straight, with no natural wave or curl. Used in talk about hair types, at the hairdresser's and in descriptions of people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{直毛|ちょくもう}だ。
{直毛|ちょくもう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦パーマ→パーマ：28205_paama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかり→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧にくい。
examples.english: My hair is straight, so perms don't take well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{直毛|ちょくもう}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似|に}て→似る：01159_niru⟧⟦くせ{毛|げ}→くせ毛：32906_kusege⟧だ。
examples.english: My mother has straight hair, but I take after my father and have wavy hair.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直毛|ちょくもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person with straight hair
- ⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧{直毛|ちょくもう}: stiff straight hair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦くせ{毛|げ}→くせ毛：32906_kusege⟧: naturally wavy or unruly hair — the opposite
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}パーマ→天然パーマ：33048_tennenpaama⟧: natural curls
- ⟦ストレート→ストレート：11630_sutoreeto⟧: straight (hair), the loanword used for straightened hair and hairstyles
